description: Live R4 evidence: one cross-family reviewer lane run on GitHub Copilot CLI, three reps, on an executed phase with a real diff; the record gives the lane id, reps, the parseable-verdict interval and the majority verdict.
why: Program R4's evidence gate: one paid lane run. `pan-tools review cross-family 1 --host copilot --reps 3` runs the read-only review on Copilot (a different model family) three times. Copilot spends premium requests, not USD: the lane runs as a cli step marked paid, which counts as the scenario's model step and spends none of --max-usd, and nothing parses a cost from it.

steps.why: Phase 1's work lands as its own commits on top of the seed, so the review has a base and a non-empty diff.
The engine finds the phase base and src/cart.js in scope: without it the reviewer would be handed nothing to review.
Free check before the paid step: the lane is wired for Copilot and its prompt carries the phase diff.
Three reps on Copilot CLI: each returns a pan-verdict block, the lane keeps one for review-deep, and the record has the lane id, reps, the interval over parseable reps and the majority verdict.
